Correto. The fingernail (nail plate) corresponds to stratum corneum and rests on a nail bed of strata basale and spinosum. The nail root lies in an epidermal fold, whose stratum corneum forms the eponychium (cuticle). Beneath the root is the nail matrix, the germinative portion of the nail. The hyponychium, a thickened epidermis, secures the nail at the fingertip. Upper 4x; Lower 20x

Correto. Apocrine sweat glands are characterized by their large size and wide lumens. The ducts of these glands open into hair follicles near those of the sebaceous glands. Like eccrine sweat glands, apocrine sweat glands are classified as simple coiled tubular glands, but contrary to their name, they secrete by the merocrine mode. Apocrine sweat glands are located in the anal (shown here), areolar and axillary regions. 100x
